title: The real box (&)
instructions: When you give a box to a job, the job normally gets a copy. Changing the copy doesn't change yours.
Put & after the type, like int& n, and the job gets the real box instead.
This is the same bug as the Piggy bank program in Practice!
task: This program has a bug: double_it changes a copy. Fix it so it prints:  Before: 4  then  After: 8
hint:
Give the job the real box by adding &:
